title: Reversal Share When Refunds Without Return Close a Line
content:
Under the refund-without-return reversal schedule of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships, the reversal share of the refund the schedule settles depends on the line's records on Northgate Store and Online Orders — the units bought, every refund without a return on the line and any price adjustment on it — and on the earning's entries on the membership ledger.

1. When the units refunded without a return on all such refunds of the line reach the units bought on it, the reversal share is the earned amount less the Cash already reversed on that earning (the total of the reversal entries already booked against it).
2. When they fall short of the units bought and the line carries a price adjustment, the reversal share is the earned amount multiplied by the units on this refund, divided by the units bought.
3. In every other case this rule does not set the reversal share.

**Hypothetical cases (line of 5 units, earning 5.00)**

| Refunds without a return on the line | Price adjustment | Already reversed | Reversal share under this rule |
|---|---|---|---|
| all 5 units, this refund covering the last 2 | either | 3.00 | 5.00 less 3.00, that is 2.00 |
| 2 of 5 units, this refund covering 2 | yes | 0.00 | 5.00 multiplied by 2, divided by 5, that is 2.00 |
| 2 of 5 units | no | 0.00 | not set by this rule |
